# Tebex (optional third-party)

Official **Tebex Folia** plugin for Hub web-store command delivery.

| | |
|--|--|
| License | **GNU GPLv3** |
| Upstream | https://github.com/tebexio/Tebex-Minecraft |
| Install | `./scripts/fetch-tebex.sh` → `plugins/tebex.jar` |
| Setup | Dashboard **Tebex store** or Hub console `tebex secret <key>` — [TEBEX.md](../../docs/ops/TEBEX.md) |

YaPcore does **not** vendor this jar in git (same policy as stock Folia). Redistribution
in release zips is allowed under GPLv3 when `NOTICE.txt` + `LICENSE-GPLv3.txt` ship
alongside the binary and source is available from upstream. YaPcore itself is also GPLv3.

Setup: [docs/ops/TEBEX.md](../../docs/ops/TEBEX.md)
